from pathlib import Path
from typer.testing import CliRunner
from mcp.cli.cli import app


def test_cli_limits_empty_server(tmp_path: Path):
    server_file = tmp_path / "empty_srv.py"
    server_file.write_text("from mcp.server import MCPServer\nmcp = MCPServer('test')\n")
    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(app, ["limits", str(server_file)])
    assert (result.exit_code, result.output) == (0, "")


def test_cli_limits_tools_exit_code(tmp_path: Path):
    server_file = tmp_path / "srv_tools.py"
    server_file.write_text(
        "from mcp.server import MCPServer\n"
        "mcp = MCPServer('test')\n"
        "@mcp.tool()\n"
        "def echo(text: str) -> str:\n"
        "    return text\n"
    )
    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(app, ["limits", str(server_file)])
    assert result.exit_code == 0


def test_cli_limits_prints_tool_limits(tmp_path: Path):
    server_file = tmp_path / "srv_print.py"
    server_file.write_text(
        "from mcp.server import MCPServer\n"
        "from mcp.server.mcpserver.limits import LimitPolicy, RateLimit, Quota\n"
        "mcp = MCPServer('test')\n"
        "@mcp.tool(limits=LimitPolicy(rate_limit=RateLimit(max_calls=5, per_seconds=60), quota=Quota(max_calls=100), scope='session'))\n"
        "def search(q: str) -> str:\n"
        "    return q\n"
    )
    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(app, ["limits", str(server_file)])
    assert result.output.strip() == "search  rate=5/60s  quota=100  scope=session"

def test_cli_limits_does_not_run_server(tmp_path: Path):
    server_file = tmp_path / "srv_no_run.py"
    server_file.write_text(
        "from mcp.server import MCPServer\n"
        "class StrictServer(MCPServer):\n"
        "    def run(self, *args, **kwargs):\n"
        "        raise AssertionError('run was called')\n"
        "mcp = StrictServer('test')\n"
    )
    runner = CliRunner()
    result = runner.invoke(app, ["limits", str(server_file)])
    assert result.exit_code == 0
